purpose: Read-only vocabulary reference, not a production decision engine or clinical instrument.

goals.harm_reduction: I want help with harm reduction.
goals.cut_down: I want to cut down on alcohol or other substance use.
goals.stop: I want to stop drinking or using.
goals.undecided: I am not sure what I want to change.

stated_readiness.not_ready: Readiness: I am not ready to make a change.
stated_readiness.exploring: Readiness: I am exploring my options.
stated_readiness.ready_for_step: Readiness: I am ready to try a small step.
stated_readiness.making_changes: Readiness: I am already making changes.
stated_readiness.maintaining_changes: Readiness: I am maintaining changes I have chosen.
